about: Strings for Jingle Bells' felt piano (version 7), written by Composer's Assistant 2 hearing the piano (its tune and left hand): where version 6's bed played, from the first verse's refrain (bar 20) to the last chord's end (bar 70). The violas (two notes at a time at most) and the cellos (one) from the first refrain, the violins (one) in the last verse, each under the tune (loosely: the model may stray, then lay_in keeps what it wrote); notes starting about twice a bar (horiz 1: 0.5-1 a quarter note), the cellos under twice (horiz 0), the upper strings mostly by step (step 4: 60-80 % of their moves).
